g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS organisation security logging and threat detection

g.title: None.None.Node.25
g.text: The organisation trail records every API call in every account and Region
Workload VPC flow logs and Config history land in the log archive account too
through Glue tables over the immutable, Object Lock protected buckets
GuardDuty in each workload account reports to the delegated administrator
Security Hub aggregates its findings with Config compliance
An EventBridge rule matches high and critical findings
A Lambda function quarantines the affected instance
SNS and AWS Chatbot post the finding to the SecOps Slack channel
and Firehose indexes it in OpenSearch for correlation
